facts.text: Serve dessert when Axel bluffs his way into the swanky mansion party.
facts.why: Axel trails the getaway vehicle to the Playboy Mansion event and talks his way in, telling the host his group is the Board of Health sent to clean the pool.

vibe.verdict: Johnny Wishbone, Dirty Rosewood and the cement truck split print well, but the station house is generic and the mansion bluff note is dropped.
missing: Axel bluffing into the mansion as the Board of Health
ideas: Swap 'Room service club sandwich and fries' for 'Johnny Wishbone psychic special' with the St Croix Gazette joke in the note.
Swap 'Banana split' note for 'Park it next to a limo, $50', a cement truck sundae.
Swap 'Cinnamon sugar doughnuts' house note for 'Rosewood's huge pistol, one more doughnut'.
Swap 'Rosewood's tequila sunrise' note for 'Two shotguns and an overcoat, you can never have too much firepower'.
